brief.text: I want to make a video for RentOK. The video has a Mario game. The player is basically a PG owner. The obstacles in the game are basically the problems that owner faces — tenant verification, collecting rent, tenants leaving without paying rent, no place to do reconciliation, solving complaints and so on. The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app. Once it is done, Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity. It runs and kills all the obstacles and gets the flag. Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts. Duration: 30 seconds. Game identity: An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets. Visual treatment: Delegated to the creative system.
